subject: general
question: In May 2025, the Financial Services Institutions Bureau (FSIB) recommended Asheesh Pandey as the new Managing Director (MD) and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of which bank?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Union Bank of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Financial Services Institutions Bureau (FSIB)**, the headhunter for state-owned banks and financial institutions, recommended **Asheesh Pandey** for the position of **Managing Director (MD) and Chief Executive Officer (CEO)** of **Union Bank of India**.
 
• As per the recommendation made in **May 2024** (often referred to for future terms like **2025**), **Asheesh Pandey** is slated to succeed the current MD & CEO, **Ms. A. Manimekhalai**, upon the completion of her tenure. ***Hence, the statement regarding his recommendation for Union Bank of India is correct.***
 
• Prior to this recommendation, **Asheesh Pandey** served as the **Executive Director** of the **Bank of Maharashtra**, where he contributed significantly to the bank's growth and digital transformation initiatives.
 
• The selection process was conducted by a panel headed by **Bhanu Pratap Sharma**, the **Chairman** of **FSIB**. The bureau interviewed several candidates from various **Public Sector Banks (PSBs)** before finalizing the name.
 
• The final decision on the appointment will be taken by the **Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC)**, which is headed by the **Prime Minister of India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Financial Services Institutions Bureau (FSIB):**
 
 
• The **FSIB** was constituted by the **Government of India** in **July 2022**, replacing the erstwhile **Banks Board Bureau (BBB)**.
 
• It is headquartered in **Mumbai** and is responsible for recommending persons for appointment as full-time directors and non-executive chairpersons on the boards of **Public Sector Banks**, **Public Sector Insurers**, and **Financial Institutions**.
 
• The **FSIB** aims to enhance the corporate governance structure in the financial sector by ensuring a transparent and merit-based selection process.
 
 
 
• **Union Bank of India:**
 
 
• **Union Bank of India** is one of the largest **Government of India**-owned banks, established on **November 11, 1919**.
 
• The bank's corporate headquarters is located in **Mumbai**, **Maharashtra**.
 
• It was inaugurated by **Mahatma Gandhi** and was nationalized in **1969**. After the merger of **Corporation Bank** and **Andhra Bank** into **Union Bank** in **2020**, it expanded its footprint significantly across the **country**.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC):**
 
 
• The **ACC** is responsible for taking final decisions on several top-level appointments in the **Government of India**, including heads of **PSBs** and **Regulatory Bodies**.
 
• The committee consists of the **Prime Minister** and the **Minister of Home Affairs**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Candidate Background:** **Asheesh Pandey** has over **three decades** of experience in the banking sector, having worked in various capacities across **Bank of Maharashtra**, **IDBI Bank**, and **Corporation Bank**.
 
• **Tenure and Eligibility:** Typically, the **MD & CEO** of a **Public Sector Bank** is appointed for a term of **3 years**, which may be extended based on performance and the retirement **age** of **60 years**.
 
• **Significance of the Move:** This recommendation is part of a broader cycle of leadership changes in **Indian PSBs** as the **government** seeks to strengthen the management of major lenders to support **economic growth** and manage **Non-Performing Assets (NPAs)** effectively.
</ul
